That's you.|audio = Null&VoidN2Wave5-1.ogg|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 5 ([[Banlands]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Null Shrieker''' was a [[Flying]] enemy that appeared in [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had a decent amount of health and speed. As it was a [[Flying]] enemy, only towers with flying detection can target it. ==Logbook Description== "''The Null Shrieker is a flying enemy within the Nil Zone. Despite its blindness, it navigates by relying on sound to locate its prey. The bandages that cover its eyes are believed to be self-inflicted, as if the creature chose to blind itself.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Shrieker''' appearance resembles that of a giant bat, with purple fur, sharp teeth along with claws on its legs and arms, bat wings and pointy ears. It has an orange blindfold covering its eyes. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *Cheap early-game towers with flying detection like [[Golden Soldier]], [[Engineer]] and [[Crook Boss]] along with its goons can be used to take them down comfortably. **Later on, towers like the [[Pursuit]] or [[Ranger]] can also be used to deal with them. *You can use the [[Firework Technician]] to give all towers within its range flying detection, making '''Null Shrieker''' easier to kill. **Similarly, [[The Sun]] curse also gives all your towers to detect it but at the cost of it having all immunities, making it slightly harder to slow down. *As the '''Null Shrieker''' is quite fast and on some waves spawn as [[Nimble]], stalling towers can be useful against it. **Due to it being a [[Flying]] enemy, not only does that mean the tower has to be able to detect it, but some that do cannot stall it at all. This heavily limits potential stalling options. One tower which can be used is the [[Electroshocker]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} NullShriekerWalkAnimation.gif|Flying animation (25 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNullShrieker.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (25 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} Night2Promo.png|'''Null Shrieker''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Null Shrieker''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. NullShriekerIconIG.png|'''Null Shrieker''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Null Shrieker''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''25 October 2025''' - [[v1.78.0]] **'''Null Shrieker''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Null Shrieker''' has a broken icon. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **Now appears in [[Blind Faith]]. **{{Bugfix}} '''Null Shrieker''' now uses its correct icon. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Null Shrieker''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b ** {{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Notes== {{Banlands|[[Null Scout]]|Wave 6 (Easy)|hardt1 = [[Null Dredge]]|hardw1 = Wave 3 (Hard)|Null Shrieker|Wave 7 (Easy)|hardt2 = Null Shrieker|hardw2 = Wave 5 (Hard)|[[Lost Glitch]]|Wave 8 (Easy)|hardt3 = [[Null Scout]]|hardw3 = Wave 6 (Hard)}} {{BlindFaith|[[Null Freezer]]|Wave 6|Null Shrieker|Wave 7|[[Null Crook Boss]]|Wave 8}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
